info.title: GameAPI WebSocket Contract
info.description: Real-time contract for Tic-Tac-Toe gameplay and presence events. Both endpoints share a common envelope {event, payload} and require JWT authentication as the first message after the handshake.

development.description: Local development server (Vite proxy or direct Uvicorn).

production.description: Production deployment on Render. TLS provided by the platform. Free tier: the service sleeps after 15 minutes of inactivity; the first request after a cold start may take 30-60 seconds.

gameplays.title: Gameplays channel
gameplays.description: Real-time gameplay events: invitations, moves, turn changes, game endings.

presence.title: Presence channel
presence.description: Real-time user presence: online users, joins, and leaves.

receiveGameplayClientMessages.title: Client to server (gameplays)
receiveGameplayClientMessages.summary: Messages sent by clients on the gameplays channel.

sendGameplayServerMessages.title: Server to clients (gameplays)
sendGameplayServerMessages.summary: Messages pushed by the server on the gameplays channel.

receivePresenceClientMessages.title: Client to server (presence)
receivePresenceClientMessages.summary: Messages sent by clients on the presence channel.

sendPresenceServerMessages.title: Server to clients (presence)
sendPresenceServerMessages.summary: Messages pushed by the server on the presence channel.

auth.name: auth
auth.title: Authentication
auth.summary: Must be the first message after the WebSocket handshake.

create_game.name: create_game
create_game.title: Create game
create_game.summary: Host invites another user to a new game.

accept_invitation.name: accept_invitation
accept_invitation.title: Accept invitation
accept_invitation.summary: Accept a pending invitation to join a gameplay.

reject_invitation.name: reject_invitation
reject_invitation.title: Reject invitation
reject_invitation.summary: Reject a pending invitation to join a gameplay.

play_move.name: play_move
play_move.title: Play move
play_move.summary: Submit a move on the board. Only the player whose turn it is can move.

leave_game.name: leave_game
leave_game.title: Leave game
leave_game.summary: Abandon an active game. The opponent wins.

subscribe_game.name: subscribe_game
subscribe_game.title: Subscribe to game
subscribe_game.summary: Subscribe this socket to a game's event stream. A socket can only be subscribed to one game at a time.

unsubscribe_game.name: unsubscribe_game
unsubscribe_game.title: Unsubscribe from game
unsubscribe_game.summary: Remove this socket from the active game's channel subscription.

list_online_users.name: list_online_users
list_online_users.title: List online users
list_online_users.summary: Request the current set of online user IDs.

auth_ok.name: auth_ok
auth_ok.title: Auth success
auth_ok.summary: Sent immediately after a valid JWT is accepted.

auth_error.name: auth_error
auth_error.title: Auth failure
auth_error.summary: Sent before the socket is closed with code 4401 (invalid token) or 4408 (timeout).

game_created.name: game_created
game_created.title: Game created
game_created.summary: The hosted game has been created and the guest was invited.

invitation_received.name: invitation_received
invitation_received.title: Invitation received
invitation_received.summary: A host invites this user to a new game.

invitation_accepted.name: invitation_accepted
invitation_accepted.title: Invitation accepted
invitation_accepted.summary: A pending invitation was accepted and the board is now active.

invitation_rejected.name: invitation_rejected
invitation_rejected.title: Invitation rejected
invitation_rejected.summary: A pending invitation was rejected by the guest.

board_updated.name: board_updated
board_updated.title: Board updated
board_updated.summary: The board was advanced after a valid move.

game_ended.name: game_ended
game_ended.title: Game ended
game_ended.summary: The gameplay ended due to a line, draw, abandon, or rejection.

subscribed.name: subscribed
subscribed.title: Subscribed
subscribed.summary: The socket was subscribed to a specific game stream.

unsubscribed.name: unsubscribed
unsubscribed.title: Unsubscribed
unsubscribed.summary: The socket was removed from the active game stream.

online_users.name: online_users
online_users.title: Online users list
online_users.summary: Current online users for the presence channel.

user_online.name: user_online
user_online.title: User came online
user_online.summary: Another user joined the presence channel.

user_offline.name: user_offline
user_offline.title: User went offline
user_offline.summary: Another user disconnected from the presence channel.

error.name: error
error.title: Error
error.summary: Generic error message for invalid event, invalid payload, or domain logic failures.

token.description: JWT access token used to authenticate the websocket connection.

user_id.description: Authenticated user identifier from the JWT subject claim.

guest_id.description: Identifier of the opponent invited to the new game.

game_id.description: Unique identifier of the gameplay being accessed.
Gameplay identifier on which the move is being played.

row.description: Board row index, zero-based, from 0 to 2.

col.description: Board column index, zero-based, from 0 to 2.

user_id.description: User identifier that came online or went offline.

Board.description: 3x3 board representing the current game state. 0 = empty, 1 = host, 2 = guest.

row.description: Row index of the last move.

col.description: Column index of the last move.

player.description: Player who made the last move.

game_id.description: Unique identifier of the newly created game.

guest_id.description: Opponent invited to the new game.

board.description: Initial empty board state after the game is created.

turn.description: User ID whose turn it currently is; for a new game this is the host.

game_id.description: Game identifier for the invitation being received.

id.description: User ID of the host who sent the invitation.

name.description: Display name of the host who sent the invitation.

game_id.description: Gameplay identifier that became active after the invitation was accepted.

board.description: Board state of the game after the invitation is accepted.

turn.description: User ID whose turn it is now; the host moves first.

game_id.description: Gameplay identifier of the invitation that was rejected.

guest_id.description: User ID of the guest who rejected the invitation.

board.description: Updated board state after the move.

turn.description: User ID whose turn is next after the move.

last_move.description: Position and player for the last move that changed the board.

oneOf.description: User ID of the winner of the gameplay.
No winner; this was a draw.

winner.description: Winner user ID or null in draw scenarios.

reason.description: Why the game ended: line, draw, abandon, or rejected invitation.

code.description: Machine-readable error code for the problem.
